name: auto-pin
description: Pins every session in the Code-tab sidebar when it starts and unpins it after it sits idle

idleHours.title: Unpin after idle hours
idleHours.description: Unpin a session auto-pin pinned once it has had no activity for this many hours. 0 never unpins. Pins you make yourself are never touched.

repinOnMessage.title: Re-pin on every message
repinOnMessage.description: Pin the session again each time you send it a message, even if you unpinned it. Off: sessions are pinned only when they start, and an unpin lasts until the session restarts.
